text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and verify that different parts of a system work together properly. Many developers also use test-driven development, where tests are written before the code itself. This approach helps programmers think clearly about what they want to build. Good tests give teams confidence that their software is reliable and that new changes will not break existing features. Although writing tests takes time, it saves much more time later by catching problems early.
